notes.title: The Slater - Difficulty options added (Update October 29, 2018)
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings everyone! The Slater has now three difficulty options to choose from. Normal difficulty corresponds to the difficulty before the update. [/h1] 

[b] Easy [/b] 
- Slow enemy reactions
- Slow global alert
[b] Normal [/b] 
- Fast enemy reactions
- Fast global alert
[b] Hard [/b] 
- No tutorial
- Additional enemies
- Additional surveillance cameras
- Less items and pickable clothes
- Casualties are inevitable

[b] Other updates[/b] 
- Some level changes
- Minor bug and collision fixes

notes.title: The Slater - Update September 30, 2018
notes.notes:
- Added resolutions 3840 x 2160, 3440 x 1440, 2560 x 1600.
- Support for ultrawide resolutions.
- Fixed HUD issues with different resolutions.

notes.title: The Slater - Update September 26 & 27, 2018
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue with never ending slow motion.
- Fixed buttons in code panels not being readable with low settings.
- Fixed room numbers not being readable with low settings.
- Fixed camera settings from level completion screen.
- Fixed floating screens in level 2.
- Changes to rating system.
- Player will not choke while gun is transitioning into hand anymore.
- Fixed some dynamic objects flickering in level 3.
- Some optimization for level 4.
- Minor level changes and fixes.

notes.title: The Slater - Update September 24, 2018
notes.notes:
[h1] New features available! [/h1] 

[B][u]Rating statistics[/u][/B]
- Added rating system, kill statistics and time on level completion.
[B][u]Kill only targets[/u][/B]
- All levels can now be completed without killing anyone but the targets.
- Level modifications and new routes on some levels.
[B][u]Player damage[/u][/B]
- Player takes now damage and won't die from the first bullet.
[B][u]Enemy accuracy[/u][/B]
- Enemies will miss more shots.
[B][u]Steam achievements[/u][/B]
- Added Steam achievements for completing levels with Master rating. (Kill only targets)
[B][u]Other[/u][/B]
- Collision fixes and other minor fixes.

notes.title: The Slater - Update September 21, 2018
notes.notes:
- Added possibility to turn head-bobbing on/off.
- Added possibility to adjust field of view.
- Fixed some collision issues.

A big thank you to everyone who bought the game. I will continue working on it. If you find any glitches or issues please let me know and I'll do my best to resolve them as quickly as possible. Thanks.

notes.title: The Slater is out now!
notes.notes:
[h1] Greetings everyone! [/h1] 

I’m happy to announce The Slater is finally available to be bought on Steam. Hopefully you will enjoy the game as much as I did developing it for the past years.

If something unexpected happens or you run into any kind of issues, please send me an email to [b]support@lainainteractive.com[/b]  and I’ll do my best to resolve the issue as soon as I possibly can. I might need to sleep at some point, but I guess couple hours and a cup of coffee will have to do it.

Now, let’s get those drug lords killed!
- Alessandro Laina

https://store.steampowered.com/app/881690/The_Slater/

notes.title: Do you want to participate in final beta testing stage?
notes.notes:
Release date is now set and it's getting closer day by day. I would like to offer the community a chance participate in final beta testing stage. I am looking for members who would complete the game, and most importantly would be willing to [b]report any bug or problem if one occurs[/b]. It would be appreciated if the play through would be done within a few days after receiving the invite.

If you are interested, please [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1jNEuKn60rCX6-M9urVb5mQ-4Af4L8JKV6ZEvp6pE3M4/edit] fill in the form. [/url] 

Bare in mind, there is only a limited amount of beta keys to be given. If you are picked, you will receive an email within a few days. Thanks!

notes.title: The Slater is set to release on September 20th 2018. New trailer available.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Excited to announce The Slater is set to release on September 20th 2018. Step into the shoes of a former cop Mark Slater and get ready to kill drug dealers, crime bosses and anyone who stands in your way as you seek revenge for your father’s murder. The Slater is a story-driven first-person stealth-action game with mechanics relying heavily on observation, disguises and distractions. Check out the brand new trailer.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cdZhVG0V6nw

Can't wait and would already want to get involved? Stay tuned, more exciting news coming shortly.
